fact: Decree 2023-515 of 9 May 2023 gives CNECI the generation of the unique number (NUI), assigned from birth through the civil registration system SIECM and attached to civil and identity records, with interconnection of the civil and identity registers with third-party bases requiring CMIL authorisation.
title: Décret n° 2023-515 relatif au Numéro Unique d'Identification (NUI)
